capabilities: Receive article links submitted from the 同步链接 WeChat Mini Program
Fetch and convert web articles to Markdown on the desktop
Download article images into the vault
Manage a processing queue with pending, processing, done, failed and trash records
Paste links directly for local-only import without a server record
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not limited to WeChat articles; it also extracts Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Douban and other public pages via a generic extractor.
extras: Desktop only (Windows and macOS); the Mini Program, server and database are not in the public repo; links requiring login, CAPTCHA or strong anti-bot protection may fail to parse; PRIVACY.md covers what is synced (link, note, tags, status) versus kept local (article bodies).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to receive article links sent from a phone (WeChat) and convert them into local Markdown notes on the desktop.

relations.evidence: WeChat Link Sync connects Obsidian Desktop with the companion WeChat Mini Program “同步链接”

requires.name: 同步链接 WeChat Mini Program

summary: Web-clipper companion that receives article links from a WeChat Mini Program and saves them as local Markdown notes with images.
